title: Cedar dining pavilion, two recessed graphite heaters in the recess kit, in line running into the scene, centred over the dining table for eight
background: generated plate (no heater, no people, no lettering): covered terrace with cedar-board ceiling about 2.4 m, dining table for eight, garden at dusk (same plate and solved camera as pr-bg-white-ceiling-cedar-dining-f14)
source: CAD: '6kW heater and recess kit' (Series II 6 kW in the kit; the kit trim BMC-00659 is the only trim in the CAD, marked obsolete there). Two kits flush in the cedar boards, long axis with the boards running into the scene (owner: 'going into the image'), one behind the other, 2.2 m centre to centre (about 0.5 m between kits), centred left to right on the table and about 0.3 m behind its centre so the near kit stays whole in frame. Rendered in Blender (Cycles), composited by the content team; graphite graded to a neutral warm grey (R>=G>B), elements deep orange (about 200/119/61).
review_note: Near heater's BROMIC end-cap logo reads upright. Kit trim is the CAD's obsolete BMC-00659 (only trim available). The kit gap assumes a 1.68 m trim; confirm with the Product team.
